page.notes: The asterisk before "Carmani" and "Carma" marks a reference; the page's marginal marks are symbols only. Several words are uncertain in the dense printed Latin, notably "Carmani", "Pharusi" and "Latyram", but were copied as read. Long s was normalised to s as per the rules; some marks (macron, ligatures) may be imperfect.
